name: Sofa, Roche Bobois Script 194, 2.5-seater

clearance.note: Legroom in front of the seat; a coffee table can stand 45 cm away

notes: Roche Bobois Script (design Sacha Lakic), module 34: "Banquette 2,5 places", the 2.5-seat armless sofa, 194 cm. Sizes from Roche Bobois's technical sheet (technicals.roche-bobois.com/M191834697/TDSv_SCRIPT_2026.pdf, pages 2–3): 194 wide, 121 deep, 85 high, seat height 43, feet 4 high; two back cushions 92 wide, each with a 79 wide lumbar cushion fixed in front of it, the seat 56 deep in front of those. Armless, so modules stand side by side; this is the module on its own. Shown with the backs closed, their normal position: each back cushion sits on a rocking mechanism that opens it 27 cm further back (148 deep overall), and the planner shows the one position, so plan for the 121 cm and leave room behind to open the backs. model.glb is generated by `npx tsx tools/models/roche-bobois-script.ts` from its own geometry after the sheet's drawings and Roche Bobois's photos: a low base of four segments running from front to back, plump and domed with soft channels between them, the block behind the seat carrying the back cushions; two thick rounded back cushions leaning back, each with its lumbar roll; small square feet in wengé-stained beech, set well in. Roche Bobois makes Script only in its stretch fabrics (Bamboo, Chroma, Orsetto Flex, Passion, Pixel, Smile Flex, Techno 2D, 3D and 4D) and shows it in green Orsetto Flex; the fabrics here are planning colours, not Roche Bobois's, the default cream bouclé among them, as are the dark browns (fabric.espresso, fabric.dark-chocolate, fabric.dark-walnut, fabric.dark-umber). The seat is a surface, so cushions and throws can go on it.
